scores_provenance.dino: facebookresearch/dinov2 dinov2_vits14 (torch hub, Apache-2.0), 22056576 params, device mps

definition: Mann-Whitney AUROC, target probes vs swapped-decoy probes per azimuth bin, pooled over distance (3,6,12 m), 2 random suns, 2 jitter reps and 10 layouts; 95% CI = percentile bootstrap over layouts (2000). Catchment = consecutive 15-deg bins from 0 with AUROC >= 0.75.

bytes.notes: MB: 20,000 1-bit KC->MBON weights; PN->KC wiring regenerated from seed (400,000 B if stored as uint16). pixels uint8 32x32 per view; colour uint16 512 bins per view; DINO fp16 384-d per view, weights fp32.

ms_note: one query vs the 13-view memory, M4, numpy CPU for pixels/colour/MB, DINOv2 on mps, excl. rendering
